name: amendment-history
author: Anthropic and upstream contributors

license.scope: Inspected controlling LICENSE and repository file inventory; no nested exception in this skill subtree.
obligations: Provide a copy of Apache-2.0 to recipients.
Retain applicable copyright, patent, trademark and attribution notices; preserve any applicable NOTICE.
Prominently identify modified files; license grants no general trademark rights.

assignments.essential_function: Trace contract changes and exact clause versions across a base agreement and its amendments.

review: Selected unchanged for contract amendment chronology and provision tracing. Full source compares the base agreement and amendments, quotes before/after text with section references, summarizes current language and flags ambiguity or conflicting documents for Legal rather than deciding conflicts. Direct uploads are supported; CLM and repository retrieval are explicitly marked coming soon. This does not extract a comprehensive obligations register.
native_prerequisites: Complete base agreement and all relevant amendments, uploaded or pasted
Native commercial-legal practice configuration and support instructions; optional matter folder isolation
Document-reading capability; CLM/repository retrieval must not be advertised as already implemented
evidence_qualification: Lower-adoption specialist selection: 566 installs. Publisher/repository evidence and substantive source review support selection, but individual uptake is smaller and effectiveness is not independently proven.
packaging_notes: Native commercial-legal configuration and source-context loading remain required. Parent instructions describe plugin-root references, while the pinned upstream repository stores reference templates at repository root; no corrective mirror is included.
